card.fact_statement: China hosted an informal meeting in Shanghai with Cambodian and Thai officials to reaffirm their commitment to the ceasefire.
card.source_span: Following ceasefire accusations at the United Nations General Assembly in New York City, China hosted an informal meeting in Shanghai with Cambodian official Kung Phaok and Thai executive advisor Jullapong Nonsrichai, in which both sides reaffirmed their commitment to the ceasefire.

card.fact_statement: The European Union provided €2.5 million in initial emergency assistance to Myanmar.
card.source_span: The European Union (EU) provided a total of €2.5 million in initial emergency assistance to Myanmar, along with a humanitarian airlift operation to convey 80 tons of emergency supplies to Mandalay
